coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 5 ground-truth variable items (60%): JaxMARL/SMAX with fixed hardware resources, MAPPO versus QMIX, and training time to a defined convergence threshold.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Selects 6 maps rather than 9 and includes maps exceeding the 10-unit restriction. Normalizes returns by subtracting a random-policy baseline rather than simply dividing the score by the scenario maximum. Also adds IPPO and VDN beyond the specified algorithm comparison.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Omits both the expected 6× training-speed advantage for PPO and its expected superior normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios due to greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
